utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Oren — that should help a lot.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Glad to help — I’ll bring the gloves and flashlight, and I can still lend a hand if you need another volunteer.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: That would mean a lot, Oren — thank you.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sure — put my name down too. Just tell me what needs doing first.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely, Leo — thank you. First, let’s set up at the community center on Sunday and then we can sort items into repair, donate, and recycle.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Got it — I can help set up at the community center on Sunday. I’ll start sorting items into the three piles once we’re there.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yep, I’ve got the spare gloves, a marker, and a few small tools. I’ll head over soon.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Sounds good—send it over when you have it, and I’ll work around pickup and drop-off times.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it — I’ll send it over soon and keep it quick around the pickup window.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing—I can bring over a few tools for the repair drive. If you want, I’ll swing by around 2 o’clock.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: That’d be great, Gus—around 2 works for me. I’ll check our supplies and let you know if we’re still short on anything.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Perfect, I’ll see you around 2 and bring the tools. Just let me know if you end up needing anything else.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I can help, but I’d like the plan clear first—what still needs doing for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Eli — the drive has moved to Sunday at the community center. I’ll help get the plan clear; what part do you want to tackle?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I can handle checking the drop-off table and making sure the timing is posted clearly. If you tell me the exact hours, I’ll stick to that.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: It’s shaping up well already—people are pitching in, and I can pass along the details if you want. I’ll also see what they still need.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Tess — could you share the new Sunday time and community center location? I want to make sure I get there on time.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Of course — it’s now on Sunday at the community center, and I’ll pass along any other updates if I hear them.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ve got you down, and I’ll bring you the repair drive details this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Quinn — I’ll start with the community center and wait for the time and date this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: You got it, Opal — I’ll swing by this afternoon with the time and date for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: I’m still missing tools and a few spare parts for the repair drive this Saturday. If you hear of any extra supplies, send them my way.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Yes, we’re still on for the repair drive. I can keep an eye out for extra supplies — do you want me to bring the spare gloves, a marker, and a few small tools too?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yes please — the spare gloves, marker, and a few small tools would be great. Thanks, Hana; I’ll keep you posted if I hear of anything else.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’m not sure of the full list yet, but I can help check what’s missing. If you’ve got any supplies already, bring those and I’ll sort through the rest.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good — I’ll bring whatever supplies I’ve got and help sort through the rest.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Sam — that helps a lot. I’ll check what’s still missing and let you know if anything else comes up.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I’ll keep spreading the word about the repair drive and remind folks to bring any tools or spare parts they can. I can also help make sure everyone knows when and where it’s happening.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Vik — that’s really helpful. I’m still happy to pitch in, just let me know if there’s anything specific you want me to do.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Thanks, Dane — could you help spread the word too and remind people it’s this Saturday? If you can, please mention we’re gathering tools and spare parts for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh nice — how’s the repair drive going so far?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: It’s going pretty well so far—I’m happy to help however I can. What’s the latest on your end?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Good to hear — I’ve been running errands, and I just wanted to check if you still need anything for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’m checking around now and I’ll let you know who still needs help and when they need it.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Nell. Please let me know who still needs help and when they need it.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’m on it — I’ll ask around and bring you the latest as soon as I hear back.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I can help spread the word for the repair drive—what do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, you’re still good to help spread the word for the repair drive today, right?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely, I’m still good to help spread the word today. Just tell me what you want me to say.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’m still waiting on the details too, but I can help once we know what supplies and timing you need.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Rey — since it’s now Sunday at the community center, I just want to confirm the start time and what supplies to bring so nothing gets missed.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’m still waiting on the final list too, but if you hear the start time, I can help make sure the supplies are covered.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure — what do you need me to do for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I’ve got the gloves, a marker, and some small tools — just let me know where to drop them off.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Great, thanks — you can drop them off at my place, and I’ll handle the rest.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I haven’t heard the latest myself—what’s the word on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’m checking what we’ve got on hand now, and I’ll let you know which tools and screws are still missing.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, I’d appreciate that—just tell me what’s still needed when you know.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely—I’ve got you down. I’ll spread the word about the repair drive this afternoon and bring you the details, too.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, thanks Quinn — I’m good with that. I’ll bring my gloves and flashlight, and I can help out at the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect, Oren—thanks for pitching in! I’ll swing by this afternoon with the details and make sure everyone knows you’re helping out.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Where should I track first for the repair drive, and can you confirm the meeting location?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help coordinate around pickup and drop-off—just send me the time and place when you have it, and I’ll work around the school schedule.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Got it — I’ll keep track of the place first. What meeting location should I note for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I’m late — I can help with the repair drive. What still needs doing?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Dane — I’m still a bit short on tools and spare parts for the repair drive. If you can help round up any of that, that’d be great.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it — I’ll see what I can round up for tools and spare parts. I’ll let you know what I find soon.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Vik. That would help a lot.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Of course — I’ll keep everyone posted and remind folks to bring any tools or spare parts they can. I’ll also make sure they know when and where the repair drive is happening.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Vik. I really appreciate you keeping everyone in the loop.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — I can bring over a few tools for the repair drive if you still need them.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Yes, that would be great — tools would really help. I’m headed out now, so I can coordinate the drop-off if you’re able to bring them over.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — I can bring them over now and coordinate the drop-off with you.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good — send the list over, and I’ll check it against what we already have.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely — I’ll send the list, and just a reminder it’s now on Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Got it — I’ll watch for the list and check what we already have.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I can help spread the word too, if you’d like. Just let me know when and where the repair drive is, and I’ll keep it simple.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: That’d be great, Eli—thanks. I’m still waiting on the final time and place, but I’ll pass them along as soon as I get them.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Perfect—just send me the time and place when you have them, and I’ll stick to the plan.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks for checking in, Mina — the repair drive is now on Sunday at the community center. I can help sort the next tasks if you’d like.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great — I can help sort tasks. What should I tackle first at the community center?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Great — could you start by setting out the sign-in sheet and sorting the donated items into clear piles?
